item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will lessen over the weekend. An area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Trases will skirt the western coast of the Korean Peninsula today and weaken gradually. Tropical Cyclone Songda will dissipate gradually over the Yellow Sea today and tomorrow.
